text.$description: Type scale: size, line height and weight per role, no family (pick it with font.*). The default is the comfortable scale of the sites; kommandant overrides it with the dense one.

control-xs.$description: Text in an xs control (design#243). Weight 400: a Button sets its own semibold; a pack changes size and leading here

control-sm.$description: Text in a small control (design#243). Weight 400: a Button sets its own semibold; a pack changes size and leading here

control-md.$description: Text in a control and a text field (design#243). Weight 400: a Button sets its own semibold; a pack changes size and leading here

control-lg.$description: Text in a large control (design#243). Weight 400: a Button sets its own semibold; a pack changes size and leading here
